race.description: Racing Nation On Power Fm Mdn Hcp
race.comment: HELLO MISTRESS (4) gets the nod in her stable debut, resuming for Nick Keal with first-time blinkers and a 3kg claim to sharpen her up. Her last start Ballarat Synthetic fourth was plain on the margin, but she had been consistently respected in the market and brings stronger upside than most of these. HELLAVALEGACY (5) is the danger if she reproduces the narrow second at this track two starts back, where she was beaten just over half a length on heavy ground, though her Gatton failure has to be set aside. REIGN OF DAME (7) resumes off an Inner Track trial and has placed three times from five starts at this track. LOVE AND PAIN (6) is better judged on the Warwick placing than the wide-run Gatton flop, and four placings from four tries around this trip keep her in the minor-winning mix.
